categories.main_business_segments: Chien Shing Stainless Steel Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the production of stainless steel cold-rolled coils, focusing on 300 series stainless steel products. The company also operates in steel smelting, rolling, secondary steel processing, and related metal product manufacturing. Additionally, it is involved in machinery equipment manufacturing, electronic components, and international trade, with minor activities in real estate development and resource recycling.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes cold rolling and annealing pickling lines to produce high-quality stainless steel coils. It emphasizes process automation, real-time response systems, and online monitoring to improve production efficiency and product quality stability. The firm pursues continuous process improvements to reduce defects and enhance product consistency without relying on external technology purchases.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Chien Shing serves downstream industries including metalworking, construction, chemical processing, food machinery, household appliances, automotive parts, and electronics. Its products are mainly supplied to domestic cutting and pipe manufacturing customers, with a small portion exported internationally. The company targets both mature domestic channels and expanding export markets, focusing on customers requiring high-value, customized stainless steel products.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company's operations and sales are primarily concentrated in Taiwan, with 99% of sales domestic and 1% export. Raw material sourcing includes suppliers from Taiwan and China. The firm aims to diversify export markets beyond China to mitigate regional risks and expand global presence.
categories.supply_chain_position: Chien Shing operates in the midstream segment of the stainless steel supply chain, purchasing hot-rolled stainless steel coils from upstream steel producers and processing them into cold-rolled coils for downstream fabricators and manufacturers. It maintains close relationships with upstream suppliers to ensure stable raw material supply and pricing.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes enhancing product quality stability, reducing defect rates, and automating production and maintenance processes. It plans to collaborate with third-party technology partners to further improve quality. Strategic initiatives include expanding diversified domestic and international markets, developing high value-added niche products, and strengthening ESG practices such as carbon reduction and sustainable resource management.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through the sale of stainless steel cold-rolled coil products to industrial customers. The company does not disclose subscription or licensing revenues; income is based on product sales with pricing influenced by raw material costs and market demand.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Major domestic competitors include Tang Rong, Yieh United, Dong Meng, and Hua Xin Li Hua, with Yieh United having the largest production capacity. International competition comes from large-scale producers like the Qingshan Group in Indonesia. Chien Shing differentiates itself through in-house technology development, production automation, and cost control to maintain competitiveness in a market with overcapacity and intense price competition.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately NT$1.06 billion, a 43% increase from the previous year, but incurred a net loss of NT$246 million due to lower product prices and increased costs. Total assets were about NT$1.55 billion with equity around NT$1.46 billion. The company has experienced volatility in profitability but is focusing on stabilizing operations and improving financial structure through capital reduction and cost management.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Chien Shing emphasizes stable product quality, cost competitiveness through automation and in-house technology, and flexible customer service. It aims to replace price competition with quality leadership, offering customized high-value stainless steel products such as 1-meter materials and 430 series tailored solutions. The company also commits to sustainable manufacturing practices to align with environmental regulations and customer expectations.
